newsitem.title: GERMANY: BUBA WILL NOT HOLD NEWS CONFERENCE AFTER MEETING.
newsitem.headline: BUBA WILL NOT HOLD NEWS CONFERENCE AFTER MEETING.

text.p: The Bundesbank said it will not hold a news conference after its policy-making council meeting on Thursday.

Bundesbank officials have said the meeting will discuss the revaluation of certain central bank assets after Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer and Finance Minister Theo Waigel said they were close to resolving their dispute over the matter.
Financial markets were expecting the Bundesbank to make some kind of statement, but it is unclear whether the bank will do so.
